description: Fixed real-site test corpus for WebAble adaptations. Keep this list stable so regression results stay comparable across runs.

rules.noLogins: Never automate a login on a real site. Only the public banking demo uses its published demo credentials, entered by hand.
rules.noScraping: Load the listed pages only; do not crawl or store page content beyond test results.

sites.name: Social Security Administration
sites.why: Already well built; baseline for detecting harm caused by adaptations.

sites.name: CVS
sites.why: Popups, carousels, realistic density. Browse and search only.

sites.name: Target
sites.why: Cluttered layout, small targets, distractors. Browse and search only.

sites.name: NPR
sites.why: Reading tasks for text size, spacing, width and contrast.

sites.name: ParaBank (Parasoft demo bank)
sites.why: Public demo bank: safe login and transfer flows with no real data.

sites.name: Accessible University (before/after)
sites.why: Controlled ground truth: the same page exists in inaccessible and accessible states.

sites.name: TodoMVC (React)
sites.why: Stress test for mutation observation and re-render survival.
